name: Graph neural networks

conventions.text: Ground the method in one small toy graph of a handful of nodes (roughly three to seven) rather than an abstract box for the graph.

Give the toy graph's nodes and edges colours and repeat each colour on everything derived from that node or edge (feature cells, matrix cells, type-specific weight boxes, the arrows along its path), so paths trace by colour without labels.
Show multiplicity (per-type weights, several aggregators, a multi-layer encoder) as diagonally offset copies stacked behind the shape.
Draw node-indexed tables (pairwise encodings, latent codes, reconstructed features) as ruled grids with one row per toy-graph node.
Draw feature vectors as short strips of a few cells, or as capsules holding a few small circles.
Label nodes with italic math (v1 ... v5, t, s1, s2).

source: summarised from the evidence cards listed under each convention
